dict.string: Meety monitors Teams application windows to automatically detect when you join or leave meetings. This enables hands-free recording without collecting any personal information.
Meety uses system events to detect when Microsoft Teams meetings start and end, enabling automatic recording. No personal data is collected.
Meety records the audio of your meetings (Teams, Zoom…) played by other apps. Recordings stay on your Mac and are never uploaded automatically.
Meety reads your calendar to show today's meetings, name recordings after the event and keep its participants next to the file for transcription. Nothing leaves your Mac.
Meety saves your meeting recordings as M4A files in your Documents folder for easy access. You have full control over these files.
Meety records your voice during meetings. Your recordings are stored locally on your Mac and are never uploaded to any server.
